name: patchdiff-workbench
description: Browser-side binary patch diffing workbench for firmware security auditing

scripts.test:diff: for a in x86_64 aarch64; do for o in O0 O2; do for t in stripped unstripped; do node --import tsx tests/diff-test.ts $a $o $t; done; done; done
scripts.test: npm run test:conformance && npm run test:yara && npm run test:e2e
